name: Ace of Wands
meaning_for_today: A powerful spark of inspiration enters your life today. It is the right moment to begin something new, act boldly, and trust your creative energy.
card_advice: Do not hesitate when opportunity appears. Take initiative, follow your passion, and direct your energy toward meaningful action.

upright.short: New beginnings, inspiration, energy, creativity, enthusiasm, action.
upright.general: The Ace of Wands represents a fresh start filled with passion and potential. It signals creativity, courage, motivation, and the desire to act. This card encourages taking risks, starting projects, and embracing exciting opportunities.
upright.in_love: A passionate new connection or a renewed spark in an existing relationship. It may indicate romance, attraction, intimacy, engagement, or even pregnancy.
upright.in_situation: A favorable moment to launch new ideas, begin creative work, travel, or make bold decisions. Success comes through initiative and confidence.

reversed.short: Delays, lack of energy, hesitation, creative blocks, missed opportunities.
reversed.general: Reversed, the Ace of Wands points to frustration, lack of motivation, postponed plans, or blocked creativity. Energy may feel scattered or wasted.
reversed.in_love: Passion may weaken due to uncertainty or emotional distance. There can be hesitation in starting or developing a relationship.
reversed.in_situation: Projects may slow down or fail to develop because of fear, indecision, or poor timing. It is important to regain focus and confidence.
